card.name: Space before a number in dates
card.fires_on: The blank space right before a number, mostly the day or year in a date (after a month name or "on the"). It also fires before other figures such as quantities, doses and edition numbers.

modes.label: Dates
modes.description: Space after a month name, before the day or year.

modes.label: Quantities and doses
modes.description: Space before a count, weight or dose figure.

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words for repeat counts and rounds (like 多次, 三次, 一轮), which is a weak sign of number-related continuation.
card.plain: It fires on the space just before a number, most often the day or year in a date.
